prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot arm to pick up an empty uncapped test tube from test tube rack 2 and move it to dispensing device to draw silicone solution.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: test tube rack 2
What the inspection checks: Check whether there is an empty uncapped test tube on test tube rack 2.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: Centre of frame: a dark grey/black rack with rectangular cut-out windows, sitting on a white platform with a white plastic fixture and an aluminium extrusion frame below. One clear cylindrical tube/vial stands upright in the rack, uncapped, holding a colourless liquid roughly two-thirds up; the other slots appear empty. Behind and right, a black vertical post with a black cable runs up to a pink/magenta sign bearing a white ArUco-style marker and text reading "机器人..." and "Robot Prod...". Another black-and-white marker tag is at lower right on a white panel. Left background: a white benchtop instrument with a grey top and a dark angled bar, against a plain pale wall. Grey vertical rail with bolts at far right.
observations: The test tube found on rack 2 is not empty; it contains a colorless liquid.
